invariants: Five original-browser lanes and five Portable profile lanes execute exactly once without skips in the full regression.
Credential-free first launch dismisses the original provider dialog by visible mouse controls; subsequent navigation checks settled application interactivity without modifying frontend assets.
Fresh selected paired contracts, original source suites and exact scoped Cordis acceptance run for the same frozen candidate inputs.
The actual extracted archive passes isolated Python runtime and original-browser journeys; archive identity, commit and SHA256 bind the receipt.
Dirty development previews are never publishable; CI uploads only the exact clean archive named and hashed by a passing receipt.
open_questions: Remote Actions execution/publication and deferred Win7 validation are not certified by local acceptance.
identity: Pinned reference SHA, candidate commit, dirty state, source-input manifest and exact archive/receipt hashes identify each run. A preview is not formal acceptance.
ownership: The coordinator owns current gate drivers, disposable browser profiles, isolated credential-free Host environments and reports; publishing never rebuilds the archive.
ordering: Preflight and snapshot, migration check, Portable build, complete non-skipping regression, four original source suites, selected paired observations, raw Cordis and scoped acceptance, extracted archive runtime/browser, unchanged-input check, then receipt-bound upload.
errors: Missing required lanes, observer/runtime failure, stale or unsuccessful observations, archive mismatch, source drift and dirty release candidates fail closed. Raw C58 divergence is permitted only by the existing exact-signature acceptance checker.
cancellation: Delete an old summary before starting; interrupted or failed runs do not produce publishable success. CI success and archive hash checks precede upload.
adaptation: Current Windows, Python 3.8.10 and pinned Node development observer only; no full upstream parity, remote-model authentication or Windows 7 certification is claimed.
